# Creating Custom Blocks (Summary)

Source: https://hytalemodding.dev/en/docs/guides/plugin/creating-block

## Purpose
Create custom blocks using asset packs.

## Key concepts
- Enable asset packs via `IncludesAssetPack` in `manifest.json`.
- Organize assets under the expected server resources structure (items, textures, models, translations).
- Define the block’s item JSON with translation keys, stack size, texture, and block type settings (material, draw type, sounds, decals).

## Notes
- Ensure all referenced asset files exist and paths match the expected layout.
